summary: Final state of the run, submitted unchanged (the controller reports no_change). Before stopping I ran a consistency check of the two current accounts against their retained receipts: 42 spot-checked claims across 13 receipts, covering every index either account relies on (the single-voter recovery and its controls, the three-voter commit-rule witness, the durable-snapshot case, the authority pair including the repeat where its premise failed and the revised execution where it held, the block and bound pairs, the exact boundary, the default-configuration case and the availability pair in all three of its executions), matched the observations with no discrepancies. Both investigations are complete: the configuration-recovery question cites six receipts with conclusion violated and defect asserted, its authority precondition stated explicitly, eight counterevidence items and five limitations; the replay-completion question cites nine receipts with conclusion violated and defect asserted, a bound measured at 128 delivered batches and shown to be reachable with default settings, six counterevidence items and four limitations. Every pair of cases in the replay account now has at least two executions, and the two accounts' remaining limitations are structural (in-memory transports and stores in one process, no production store, no process-level restart or disk fault), which cannot be removed within the remaining allocation without leaving an uncited receipt, so no further work is initiated.
